name: Jeans
_about: blue jeans (Levi Strauss & Jacob Davis, 1873; everyone's trousers from the 1950s): heavy cotton denim, a 3/1 twill of indigo warp over white weft, five pockets, from the waist to the instep, a little loose, its waistband standing proud (the seat's patch pockets are left out: the figure engine reads six layers a part, and a hi-vis vest over a t-shirt over the jeans' seat spends them all)
